title: Fire breaks out in two coaches of Samastipur-Saharsa MEMU train
summary: A fire broke out in the motor coach of a Samastipur-Saharsa MEMU train as it arrived at Simri Bakhtiyarpur station around 3 a.m. The station master reported the incident, and East Central Railway's Chief Public Relations Officer, Saraswati Chandra, confirmed that no injuries were reported.
summary_points: A fire broke out in the motor coach of a Samastipur-Saharsa MEMU train as it arrived at Simri Bakhtiyarpur station around 3 a.m.
The station master reported the incident to East Central Railway's Chief Public Relations Officer, Saraswati Chandra.
No injuries were reported in the fire.
East Central Railway's Chief Public Relations Officer, Saraswati Chandra, confirmed the details of the incident.
